papers.title_en: Physics-Informed State Space Models for Reliable Solar Irradiance Forecasting in Off-Grid Systems
papers.evidence: 用于太阳辐照度预测的状态空间模型
papers.tldr: 针对离网光伏系统对高效且符合物理规律的太阳辐照度预测需求，本文提出物理增强状态空间模型（PISSM）。该模型结合动态Hankel矩阵嵌入过滤噪声，利用线性状态空间模型替代复杂注意力机制以提升效率，并通过物理门控机制确保预测符合昼夜规律。在苏丹数据集上的验证表明，该模型仅需不到4万参数即可实现高精度预测，为边缘端实时控制提供了超轻量化方案。
papers.abstract_en: The stable operation of off-grid photovoltaic systems requires accurate, computationally efficient solar forecasting. Contemporary deep learning models often suffer from massive computational overhead and physical blindness, generating impossible predictions. This paper introduces the Physics-Informed State Space Model (PISSM) to bridge the gap between efficiency and physical accuracy for edge-deployed microcontrollers. PISSM utilizes a dynamic Hankel matrix embedding to filter stochastic sensor noise by transforming raw meteorological sequences into a robust state space. A Linear State Space Model replaces heavy attention mechanisms, efficiently modeling temporal dependencies for parallel processing. Crucially, a novel Physics-Informed Gating mechanism leverages the Solar Zenith Angle and Clearness Index to structurally bound outputs, ensuring predictions strictly obey diurnal cycles and preventing nocturnal errors. Validated on a multi-year dataset for Omdurman, Sudan, PISSM achieves superior accuracy with fewer than 40,000 parameters, establishing an ultra-lightweight benchmark for real-time off-grid control.

papers.title_en: Towards Situation-aware State Modeling for Air Traffic Flow Prediction
papers.authors: Anqi Liu, Bin Wang, Jiangtao Zhao, Dechuan Ma, Guiyuan Jiang, Feng Hong, Yanwei Yu, Tianrui Li
papers.evidence: 空中交通预测的状态到流量建模
papers.tldr: 针对终端区空中交通流量预测中现有时间序列方法忽略微观状态信息的问题，本文提出AeroSense框架。该框架摒弃了传统的宏观流量聚合模式，直接将实时空域态势建模为动态飞机状态集。通过引入态势感知状态表示、掩码自注意力机制及解耦预测头，AeroSense能直接从微观运动学数据中捕捉交互并预测流量。实验证明其在预测精度、高峰期鲁棒性及可解释性方面均优于现有基准。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate air traffic prediction in the terminal airspace (TA) is pivotal for proactive air traffic management (ATM). However, existing data-driven approaches predominantly rely on time series-based forecasting paradigms, which inherently overlook critical aircraft state information, such as real-time kinematics and proximity to airspace boundaries. To address this limitation, we propose \textit{AeroSense}, a direct state-to-flow modeling framework for air traffic prediction. Unlike classical time series-based methods that first aggregate aircraft trajectories into macroscopic flow sequences before modeling, AeroSense explicitly represents the real-time airspace situation as \textit{a dynamic set of aircraft states}, enabling the direct processing of a variable number of aircraft instead of time series as inputs. Specifically, we introduce a situation-aware state representation that enables AeroSense to sense the instantaneous terminal airspace situation directly from microscopic aircraft states. Furthermore, we design a model architecture that incorporates masked self-attention to capture inter-aircraft interactions, together with two decoupled prediction heads to model heterogeneous flow dynamics across two key functional areas of the TA. Extensive experiments on a large-scale real-world airport dataset demonstrate that AeroSense consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating that direct modeling of microscopic aircraft states yields substantially higher predictive fidelity than time series-based baselines. Moreover, the proposed framework exhibits superior robustness during peak traffic periods, achieves Pareto-optimal performance under dayparting multi-object evaluation, and provides meaningful interpretability through attention-based visualizations.

papers.title_en: From Time Series to State: Situation-Aware Modeling for Air Traffic Flow Prediction
papers.authors: Anqi Liu, Jiangtao Zhao, Guiyuan Jiang, Feng Hong, Yanwei Yu, Bin Wang
papers.evidence: 用于航空交通预测的状态到流量建模

papers.title_en: INTARG: Informed Real-Time Adversarial Attack Generation for Time-Series Regression
papers.authors: Gamze Kirman Tokgoz, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing, Baris Aksanli
papers.evidence: 时间序列回归的对抗攻击生成
papers.tldr: 针对时间序列预测模型在实时场景下易受攻击且现有方法开销过大的问题，本文提出了INTARG框架。该框架在在线有限缓冲区设定下，通过知情选择策略精准打击模型置信度高且预期误差大的关键时间步。研究贡献在于实现了一种高效且隐蔽的攻击方式，仅需极低频率的干预即可显著破坏预测准确性。
papers.abstract_en: Time-series forecasting aims to predict future values by modeling temporal dependencies in historical observations. It is a critical component of many real-world systems, where accurate forecasts improve operational efficiency and help mitigate uncertainty and risk. More recently, machine learning (ML), and especially deep learning (DL)-based models, have gained widespread adoption for time-series forecasting, but they remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. However, many state-of-the-art attack methods are not directly applicable in time-series settings, where storing complete historical data or performing attacks at every time step is often impractical. This paper proposes an adversarial attack framework for time-series forecasting under an online bounded-buffer setting, leveraging an informed and selective attack strategy. By selectively targeting time steps where the model exhibits high confidence and the expected prediction error is maximal, our framework produces fewer but substantially more effective attacks. Experiments show that our framework can increase the prediction error up to 2.42x, while performing attacks in fewer than 10% of time steps.

papers.title_en: Doubly Outlier-Robust Online Infinite Hidden Markov Model
papers.authors: Horace Yiu, Leandro Sánchez-Betancourt, Álvaro Cartea, Gerardo Duran-Martin
papers.evidence: 用于预测的鲁棒在线隐马尔可夫模型
papers.tldr: 本文针对流式数据中的离群点和模型误设问题，提出了一种双重鲁棒的在线无限隐马尔可夫模型（BR-iHMM）。该方法利用广义贝叶斯推断，通过后验影响函数（PIF）定义并保证了模型的鲁棒性，并引入两个可调参数来平衡状态切换的适应性与对离群点的抵抗力。实验表明，BR-iHMM在多种实际和合成数据集上的预测性能显著优于现有的在线贝叶斯方法。
papers.abstract_en: We derive a robust update rule for the online infinite hidden Markov model (iHMM) for when the streaming data contains outliers and the model is misspecified. Leveraging recent advances in generalised Bayesian inference, we define robustness via the posterior influence function (PIF), and provide conditions under which the online iHMM has bounded PIF. Imposing robustness inevitably induces an adaptation lag for regime switching. Our method, which is called Batched Robust iHMM (BR-iHMM), balances adaptivity and robustness with two additional tunable parameters. Across limit order book data, hourly electricity demand, and a synthetic high-dimensional linear system, BR-iHMM reduces one-step-ahead forecasting error by up to 67% relative to competing online Bayesian methods. Together with theoretical guarantees of bounded PIF, our results highlight the practicality of our approach for both forecasting and interpretable online learning.

papers.title_en: Generalized Autoregressive Multivariate Models: From Binary to Poisson
papers.evidence: 离散时间序列的多变量自回归模型
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一个处理二元自回归时间序列的新框架，通过类GARCH动力学模拟伯努利变量的概率演化，支持非线性、网络交互和横向依赖。研究利用耦合论证解决了二元数据不连续性下的平稳性问题，并证明了该模型在稀有事件缩放下收敛于泊松自回归，为计数模型提供了微观基础，最后通过极大似然估计和S&P 100数据验证了其有效性。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a framework for binary autoregressive time series in which each observation is a Bernoulli variable whose success probability evolves with past outcomes and probabilities, in the spirit of GARCH-type dynamics, accommodating nonlinearities, network interactions, and cross-sectional dependence in the multivariate case. Existence and uniqueness of a stationary solution is established via a coupling argument tailored to the discontinuities inherent in binary data. A key theoretical result, further supported by our empirical illustration on S&P 100 data, shows that, under a rare-events scaling, aggregates of such binary processes converge to a Poisson autoregression, providing a micro-foundation for this widely used count model. Maximum likelihood estimation is proposed and illustrated empirically.
